description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the NationalityDao class in the OrangeHRM application's admin plugin. It tests various CRUD operations and utility methods related to the Nationality entity, including adding, editing, retrieving list/by id/by name, deleting, and checking existence.

classes.name: NationalityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHP unit test class for testing the functionalities of the NationalityDao class related to Nationality data management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating NationalityDao and setting up test fixtures.

methods.name: testAddNationality
methods.description: Tests adding a new Nationality record.

methods.name: testEditNationality
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Nationality record.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of Nationality records.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests fetching a Nationality record by its ID.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Nationality by its name with various cases and whitespace handling.

methods.name: testIsExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Tests checking for the existence of a Nationality by name.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deleting records with nonexistent IDs.
